verification.basis: Norwood LWV pages publish concrete dated civic events such as Candidates Night and election-related public programming.

notes: Monitor public candidate forums/Candidates Night, voter-registration activities, election-information sessions and public educational/civic programs. Exclude internal board/member meetings. Keep Norwood.ma listings neutral and descriptive; do not reproduce advocacy framing. Organization may publish events intermittently rather than maintain a continuous calendar. A successful check with zero current events is healthy; ingest only concrete dated public events.
